categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about property ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details. The content falls under the Land Gazette category as it primarily concerns land registration and property title matters, not government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
